english.text: Oyster reefs harbor huge amounts of life. Scores of plants and animals find food and shelter in their nooks and crannies. As the Bay's reefs wore down, that habitat was lost. Further damage came from increasing runoff from coastal farmland, deforestation and development, which silted over the flatter oyster bars, cutting off the creatures' food and dissolved oxygen. Then, in the mid-1900s came the final assault — a pair of parasites.

english.text: Through the years, Rosa Parks continued to work for the NAACP and appeared at civil rights events. She was a quiet woman and often seemed uneasy with her fame. In nineteen eighty-seven, she founded the Rosa and Raymond Parks Institute for Self-Development to improve the lives of black children.

english.text: There is such a thing as "Filipino English." Most Filipinos cannot pronounce English the way Americans do. So, when they speak English, they speak with a Filipino accent. There are also special local words that creep into it. Such includes food words like "hopia" and "pancit." But most of the time, the archipelagic lingua franca is really Taglish, the patois of code-switching between Tagalog and English. Filipinos reserve speaking pure English when Anglophone foreigners are present.

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: I’m not all that invested in the hindrance call itself – seems a pretty minor one that most of the time would go overlooked (as it was initially here), but also within the letter of the law to call it such. The problem is with the player being allowed to play out the point and only then asking for video review. That shouldn’t be allowed. It should be like the old HawkEye system where you have to stop play to initiate a challenge – otherwise they’re essentially giving players two opportunities to win the same point. (A player could also ask for video review of some trivial thing earlier in a point merely to stall and create a delay, with no downside to themselves since they don’t have to stop playing a live point to do so.) I know video review is still pretty new. I assume these kinks will be ironed out before too long.

text: 我對 hindrance call 本身唔係好在意——呢個通常都係好細嘅事，大部分時間都唔會理（就好似今次一開始都冇人理），但嚴格嚟講，根據規則都係可以叫hindrance。問題係容許球員打完個分先至申請 video review，呢個唔應該准。應該好似舊時 HawkEye 系統咁，要停低比賽先可以挑戰——否則就等於畀球員兩個機會去贏同一個分。（球員仲可以早啲喺個分入面，因為啲雞毛蒜皮嘅事申請 review 嚟拖時間，拖住玩，冇任何壞處，因為唔使停低live point。）我知道 video review 仲算新技術，我估唔使太耐，呢啲問題就會搞掂。
